    {"n": 2, "text": "Amtsgerichtsschreiber. Villemin, Joh."},
    {"n": 3, "text": "Bapt., zu à la fin de Theke."},
    {"n": 4, "text": "Notare. Racine, Joh., Sohn, zu Souby."},
    {"n": 5, "text": "\" Pretat, Franz Xaver, zu St."},
    {"n": 6, "text": "Brais."},
    {"n": 7, "text": "Forstmeister. Marchand, Jos., zu Cher="},
    {"n": 8, "text": "senay."},
    {"n": 9, "text": "Handelsleute. Debrasse, Wittib d'Eti="},
    {"n": 10, "text": "enne zu St. Brais, in Colo="},
    {"n": 11, "text": "nial und Quincailleriewaaren."},
    {"n": 12, "text": "\" Queloz, Gebrüder, zu St."},
    {"n": 13, "text": "Brais, in Colonialwaaren"},
    {"n": 14, "text": "und Mehl."},
    {"n": 15, "text": "\" Vallat, Claude, zu Epau="},
    {"n": 16, "text": "viller, in Quincailleriewrn."},
    {"n": 17, "text": "\" Vallat, Friedrich Ignaz,"},
    {"n": 18, "text": "zu Epanviller, in Quincllr."},
    {"n": 19, "text": "Amt Frutigen."},
    {"n": 20, "text": "Adelboden."},
    {"n": 21, "text": "Hinzugekommen sind:"},
    {"n": 22, "text": "Krämer. Hager, Peter."},
    {"n": 23, "text": "\" Nieder, Peter."},
    {"n": 24, "text": "\" Pieren, Jakob."},
    {"n": 25, "text": "Säumer und Fuhrmann. Jossi."},
    {"n": 26, "text": "\" Willen."},
    {"n": 27, "text": "Schlosser. Jaggi."},
    {"n": 28, "text": "Schreiber. Schranz, Peter."},
    {"n": 29, "text": "Viehhändler. Brunner, Joh., nicht mehr"},
    {"n": 30, "text": "dagegen Jossi, Gerichtsäß."},
    {"n": 31, "text": "Wirthe. Nieder, Peter."},
    {"n": 32, "text": "\" Dänzer, Gerichtsäß."},
    {"n": 33, "text": "Aeschi."},
    {"n": 34, "text": "Drechsler. Luginbühl."},
    {"n": 35, "text": "Krämer. Luginbühl, Wittib."},
    {"n": 36, "text": "Nagel- und Hufschmied. Großen, Abr."},
    {"n": 37, "text": "Pintenwirth. Müller."},
    {"n": 38, "text": "Wirth zum Bärenfuß. Nieder, hat auf="},
    {"n": 39, "text": "gehört, dagegen ist jetzt Lugin="},
    {"n": 40, "text": "bühl, Samuel."},
    {"n": 41, "text": "Dorf."},
    {"n": 42, "text": "Arzt. Müller."},
    {"n": 43, "text": "Bäcker. Jaggi, Frau."},
    {"n": 44, "text": "Gerber. Schärz."},
    {"n": 45, "text": "Krämer. Jaggi, Frau."},
    {"n": 46, "text": "\" Mürner, Christ."},
    {"n": 47, "text": "\" Klosner, Samuel."},
    {"n": 48, "text": "\" Känel, von, Christen."},
    {"n": 49, "text": "Handelsleute. Roy, Genevieve, zu Sou="},
    {"n": 50, "text": "by, in Quincailleriewaaren."},
    {"n": 51, "text": "Mechaniker. Frossard, X., zu Chocenay."},
    {"n": 52, "text": "Wirthe. Frasard, Franz, in St. Brais."},
    {"n": 53, "text": "\" Mahon in dito."},
    {"n": 54, "text": "\" Paupe, Magd., in Souby."},
    {"n": 55, "text": "\" Vallat, Justin, in Epauvillers."},
    {"n": 56, "text": "\" Farine, Joh. Bapt., in Cher="},
    {"n": 57, "text": "villers."},
    {"n": 58, "text": "\" Piquerez, Aug., zu Epiquerez."},
    {"n": 59, "text": "Müller und Saager."},
    {"n": 60, "text": "Bourgois, Viktor, zu Bollemont bei"},
    {"n": 61, "text": "St. Brais."},
    {"n": 62, "text": "Farin, Joh. Bapt., Oelmüller zu Cher="},
    {"n": 63, "text": "villers."},
    {"n": 64, "text": "Paup, Pierre Jos., zu Souby."},
    {"n": 65, "text": "Thievent, Vikt. Bapt., zu Souby."},
    {"n": 66, "text": "Emdthal."},
    {"n": 67, "text": "Arzt. Stümpel."},
    {"n": 68, "text": "Uhrenmacher. Zurbrugg, Peter."},
    {"n": 69, "text": "Wegmeister. Känel, von, Samuel."},
    {"n": 70, "text": "Faltschen."},
    {"n": 71, "text": "Dachdecker. Känel, von, Abraham und"},
    {"n": 72, "text": "Söhne."},
    {"n": 73, "text": "Krämer. Rubin, Samuel."},
    {"n": 74, "text": "Seiler. Känel, von, Abraham."},
    {"n": 75, "text": "Schieferlieferanten. Stauber & Sieber."},
    {"n": 76, "text": "Frutigen."},
    {"n": 77, "text": "Bäcker. Hinzugekommen sind:"},
    {"n": 78, "text": "Buchser."},
    {"n": 79, "text": "Gempeler, Frau."},
    {"n": 80, "text": "Mürner, Susanna."},
    {"n": 81, "text": "Fuhrleute. Dällenbach."},
    {"n": 82, "text": "\" Klopfenstein."},
    {"n": 83, "text": "Färber. Wäffler, Peter, und"},
    {"n": 84, "text": "\" Rubin, Peter, haben aufgehört."},
    {"n": 85, "text": "Gerber. Mösching, hinzugekommen."},
    {"n": 86, "text": "Geschäftsmann. Berger, P. Anton,"},
    {"n": 87, "text": "hinzugekommen."},
    {"n": 88, "text": "Holzhändler. Brügger, Gilgen."},
    {"n": 89, "text": "\" Aellig, Abraham."},
    {"n": 90, "text": "\" Hirschi, Joh."},
    {"n": 91, "text": "\" Hügli, Joh."},
    {"n": 92, "text": "\" Klopfenstein, Lieutenant."},
    {"n": 93, "text": "\" Trachsel, Obmann."},
    {"n": 94, "text": "\" Schmid, David."}
